posts.text: Wait sis, I thought the MOU was the “coolest” deal that ever happened, we love Pakistan - and anyone with questions or criticizing it is a squish neocon who should be banished from politics and was undermining Republicans?
posts.summary: Questions Pakistan MOU deal, suggests prior cheerleading was inconsistent

posts.text: I also have a lot of regrets almost a decade since my dad’s passing. My family should have forced him to step down the second he was diagnosed. Which is why I’m now an advocate for age and term limits in politics. I also sincerely hope Senator McConnell is ok.
